Salary: RM 3,000 – RM 4,000 per month

Skop Tugas dan Tanggungjawab Utama

A. Pembangunan dan Pelaksanaan AI

  1. Membangunkan penyelesaian AI mengikut keperluan dan objektif perniagaan syarikat.

  2. Mereka bentuk, membina dan menguji model AI, Machine Learning dan Generative AI.

  3. Membangunkan aplikasi AI seperti chatbot, AI assistant, recommendation system dan intelligent automation.

  4. Mengintegrasikan teknologi AI dengan sistem sedia ada seperti CRM, ERP, sistem pengurusan projek dan pangkalan data syarikat.

  5. Menilai keberkesanan model AI dari segi ketepatan, kelajuan dan kebolehgunaan bagi semua Jabatan termasuk Jabatan Marketing, Sales dan sebagainya.

B. Automasi Proses Kerja (AI Automation)

  1. Mengenal pasti proses kerja manual yang boleh diautomasikan menggunakan AI.

  2. Membangunkan sistem automasi bagi mengurangkan kerja berulang dan kebergantungan kepada proses manual.

  3. Menghasilkan workflow automasi untuk jabatan Sales, Marketing, HR, Finance, QS, Procurement dan Operations.

  4. Membangunkan sistem pemprosesan dokumen secara automatik seperti quotation, invoice, laporan dan dokumen projek.

  5. Meningkatkan kecekapan proses kerja melalui integrasi AI dengan aplikasi dan platform digital.

C. AI untuk Operasi Pembinaan dan Pengurusan Projek

  1. Meneroka penggunaan AI dalam proses pembinaan rumah dan pengurusan projek ZASMA.

  2. Membangunkan penyelesaian AI untuk membantu semakan dokumen teknikal, lukisan, spesifikasi dan laporan projek.

  1. Membantu menganalisis data projek bagi mengenal pasti risiko kelewatan, pembaziran kos dan isu kualiti.

  2. Membangunkan sistem pemantauan prestasi projek berasaskan data.

D. Data Analytics dan Business Intelligence

  1. Mengumpul, membersihkan dan menganalisis data bagi menyokong pembangunan model AI.

  2. Membangunkan dashboard dan sistem pelaporan pintar untuk pihak pengurusan.

  3. Menggunakan data bagi mengenal pasti trend, corak prestasi dan peluang penambahbaikan.

  4. Menghasilkan analisis ramalan (predictive analytics) bagi membantu proses membuat keputusan.

  5. Memastikan data yang digunakan adalah tepat, relevan dan berkualiti.

E. Integrasi Sistem dan Penyelenggaraan

  1. Mengintegrasikan aplikasi AI dengan sistem dan perisian pihak ketiga melalui API.

  2. Memastikan sistem AI berfungsi dengan baik, stabil dan boleh digunakan oleh pengguna.

  3. Menjalankan troubleshooting, debugging dan penambahbaikan sistem.

  4. Melaksanakan ujian sistem sebelum sesuatu penyelesaian AI digunakan secara rasmi.

  5. Menyediakan dokumentasi teknikal, panduan penggunaan dan rekod penyelenggaraan.

F. Penyelidikan dan Inovasi Teknologi

  1. Mengikuti perkembangan teknologi terkini dalam bidang AI, Machine Learning dan Generative AI.

  2. Menilai kesesuaian teknologi AI baharu untuk diaplikasikan dalam operasi syarikat.

  3. Menjalankan Proof of Concept (POC) bagi menguji idea dan penyelesaian AI.

  4. Mencadangkan inovasi digital yang boleh memberikan kelebihan daya saing kepada ZASMA.

  5. Membandingkan keberkesanan teknologi dan platform AI dari aspek kos, fungsi, keselamatan dan pulangan pelaburan.

G. Keselamatan dan Tadbir Urus AI

  1. Memastikan penggunaan AI mematuhi polisi keselamatan maklumat dan kerahsiaan syarikat.

  2. Mengawal akses kepada data dan sistem yang digunakan dalam pembangunan AI.

  3. Memastikan penyelesaian AI tidak mendedahkan maklumat sulit syarikat atau pelanggan.

  4. Menilai risiko kesilapan, bias dan ketidaktepatan output AI.

  5. Memastikan setiap penyelesaian AI mempunyai kawalan manusia (human oversight) bagi keputusan yang kritikal.

3. Pembangunan dan Kerjasama Antara Jabatan

  1. Bekerjasama dengan semua Ketua Jabatan dan Ketua Unit untuk mengenal pasti keperluan AI mengikut fungsi jabatan masing-masing.

  2. Mengadakan sesi perbincangan bersama pengguna bagi memahami masalah dan cabaran proses kerja.

  3. Memberikan latihan dan tunjuk ajar kepada staf berkaitan penggunaan sistem AI yang dibangunkan.

  4. Menjadi rujukan teknikal syarikat dalam penggunaan teknologi AI.

  5. Memastikan setiap projek AI yang dibangunkan dapat digunakan secara praktikal dan memberikan manfaat kepada pengguna.

4. KPI (Key Performance Indicators)

Berikut ialah cadangan KPI untuk menilai prestasi AI Engineer di ZASMA.

Aspek

KPI / Sasaran

Pembangunan AI

Minimum 2 penyelesaian AI baharu setiap suku tahun

Automasi

Minimum 2 proses kerja berjaya diautomasikan setiap suku tahun

Penjimatan masa

Mengurangkan masa proses kerja sekurang-kurangnya 20% bagi proses yang diautomasikan

Keberkesanan sistem

Minimum 95% uptime bagi sistem di bawah tanggungjawabnya

Projek AI

90% projek disiapkan mengikut tempoh yang ditetapkan

Penggunaan sistem

Minimum 80% pengguna sasaran menggunakan sistem yang dibangunkan

Penyelenggaraan

Isu kritikal sistem diberi tindakan segera mengikut SLA

Inovasi

Minimum 1 cadangan inovasi AI setiap bulan

Dokumentasi

100% projek mempunyai dokumentasi teknikal dan panduan pengguna

Nota: Sasaran KPI perlu disesuaikan mengikut skala projek, kemudahan teknologi dan sumber syarikat.

5. Kelayakan dan Kemahiran Diperlukan

Kelayakan Akademik

  • Ijazah Sarjana Muda dalam Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering atau bidang berkaitan.

  • Calon dengan pengalaman dan kemahiran teknikal yang terbukti juga boleh dipertimbangkan.

6. Ciri-ciri Individu yang Dikehendaki

  • Berfikiran strategik dan memahami keperluan perniagaan, bukan hanya aspek teknikal.

  • Mempunyai sikap ingin tahu dan sentiasa mengikuti perkembangan teknologi AI.

  • Mempunyai orientasi kepada hasil (result-oriented).

  • Mampu menterjemahkan masalah operasi kepada penyelesaian teknologi.

  • Tidak hanya bergantung kepada penggunaan tools AI sedia ada, tetapi berupaya membangunkan penyelesaian mengikut keperluan syarikat.

  • Mempunyai integriti dan bertanggungjawab terhadap keselamatan data syarikat.

Who is Artefact?

Artefact is a global consulting firm specialising in Data & AI, dedicated to transforming data into measurable business impact. We combine business consulting with deep expertise in data, AI, analytics, and technology to help organisations accelerate their transformation.

Our multidisciplinary teams bring together consultants, data scientists, data engineers, AI engineers, and technology experts to deliver impactful solutions for leading organisations around the world.

As we continue to grow our Data & AI capabilities in Southeast Asia, we are looking for an AI Engineer to join our team in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

About the Role

As an AI Engineer, you will be a hands-on builder, working on the design, development, and deployment of AI and Generative AI solutions for our clients.

You will work within multidisciplinary teams and collaborate directly with client stakeholders to transform business challenges and ideas into practical, scalable AI solutions.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Build & Deploy AI Solutions: Design, prototype, test, and deploy AI/ML and Generative AI solutions, from PoCs through to production.

  • Generative AI & LLMs: Develop solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, AI agents, and other emerging GenAI capabilities.

  • Machine Learning: Develop and integrate machine learning and deep learning models using relevant frameworks and libraries.

  • Cloud & AI Engineering: Build and deploy solutions using GCP, Azure, or AWS, including cloud-native AI services and data pipelines.

  • Solution Development: Contribute to the architecture and development of scalable, secure, and maintainable AI solutions.

  • Productionisation: Support deployment, monitoring, optimisation, and integration of AI solutions into client environments.

  • Client Collaboration: Work with business and technology stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

  • Continuous Innovation: Keep up with developments across AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, MLOps/LLMOps, and cloud technologies and apply them to real business use cases.

What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, AI/Machine Learning, or another relevant technical field.

  • Professional experience in AI Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical role.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with SQL.

  • Hands-on experience developing Machine Learning and/or Generative AI solutions.

  • Experience with LLM-related technologies such as RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, vector databases, or AI agents.

  • Familiarity with ML/AI frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, or equivalent.

  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform: GCP, Azure, or AWS.

  • Good understanding of APIs, Git, software engineering practices, and the AI development lifecycle.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with both technical and business stakeholders.

What Would Give You an Advantage

  • Experience taking AI/GenAI solutions from PoC into production.

  • Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, or other DevOps technologies.

  • Experience with frameworks and platforms for developing LLM or agentic AI applications.

  • Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or BigQuery.

  • Previous experience working in a consulting or client-facing environment.

  • Experience working on enterprise-scale Data & AI projects.

Why Join Artefact?

Work at the forefront of AI. Build real-world solutions using Machine Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, and emerging technologies.

Build, not just advise. Take ideas from experimentation and PoCs through to solutions that can be deployed and used by clients.

Work with multidisciplinary teams. Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Consultants, and AI specialists across Southeast Asia and Artefact's global network.

Develop your skills. Gain exposure to different industries, technologies, and business challenges while continuously developing your technical and consulting capabilities.

Make an impact. Help leading organisations turn AI opportunities into practical solutions and measurable business outcomes.

Come and build the future of Data & AI with us.

Role Overview: We're seeking a motivated entry-level AI Engineer to join our AI team. You’ll help build LLM-powered applications and autonomous AI agents that go into the customized software we deliver for clients across financial services, insurance, telecom, retail, and utilities.

The role is hands-on, involving turning business problems into working AI features such as retrieval-augmented applications, document-processing systems, and multi-step agents, and getting them into production alongside our senior engineers. It’s a strong opportunity for a recent graduate to build real AI engineering experience on live client projects.


Key Responsibilities:

LLM Application Development

  • Prompt Engineering: Develop and iterate on prompting strategies for reliable, task-specific outputs.

  • LLM Integration: Build applications on top of large language models for document processing, customer support automation, and financial analysis.

  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Assist in building RAG pipelines which includes chunking, embeddings, vector search, and grounding responses in client data.

  • Evaluation & Guardrails: Help test LLM outputs for accuracy and safety, and apply basic guardrails such as PII handling, prompt-injection checks, and output validation.

Agentic AI Development

  • Agent Development: Learn to build autonomous and multi-agent systems that plan and execute multi-step tasks.

  • Tool Integration: Create and integrate tools and APIs that agents use to interact with external systems.

  • Orchestration: Work with agent frameworks and orchestration tooling to compose reliable agent workflows.

Model Development

  • Model Development: Assist in training, fine-tuning, and optimizing machine learning models for classification, regression, and NLP tasks.

  • Model Evaluation: Support evaluation of model performance and help interpret results.

  • Data Preparation: Prepare and curate datasets for training and evaluation, including labeling, cleaning, and formatting.

AI Application Engineering

  • Python Development: Build Python applications, microservices, and APIs that serve AI models and agents.

  • Deployment Support: Support deployment of AI applications to production, including basic CI/CD and containerized workflows.

  • Monitoring: Help set up monitoring and alerting for model performance and application health.


Cross-Functional Responsibilities

  • Research & Development: Keep current with AI/ML and agent developments; experiment with new models, frameworks, and techniques.

  • Collaboration: Work with senior engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to identify and shape AI opportunities.

  • Documentation: Document prompts, agent designs, model architectures, and runbooks so others can build on your work.


Required Qualifications:

  • Education: Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Computing, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field. Recent graduates are welcomed.

  • Academic Foundation: Coursework in machine learning, statistics, data structures, and algorithms.

  • Programming Skills: Proficiency in Python and working knowledge of SQL, with academic or personal project experience.

  • ML Foundation: Understanding of core machine learning concepts and how models are trained and evaluated.

  • LLM Curiosity: Genuine interest in large language models, prompting, and building applications on top of them.

  • Learning Mindset: Strong desire to learn AI engineering and agent frameworks, with the adaptability to pick up new tools quickly.

  • Problem Solving: Analytical thinking and a systematic approach to AI and data problems.

  • Communication: Good written and verbal communication for collaborative work and stakeholder discussions.


Preferred Qualifications

  • LLM Experience: Personal projects, coursework, or internship experience building with LLMs (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, or open models).

  • Agent Development: Familiarity with agent frameworks such as Strands and LangChain, and orchestration with LangGraph.

  • RAG & Vector Search: Exposure to embeddings and vector databases such as OpenSearch, pgvector, or FAISS.

  • Deep Learning Frameworks: Academic projects using PyTorch or TensorFlow.

  • Data Science Libraries: Experience with Pandas and NumPy.

  • Cloud Exposure: Basic familiarity with AWS (preferred), GCP, or Azure, and with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock.

  • Containers & Version Control: Working knowledge of Docker and Git.

  • Databases: Experience with SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases.

We expect our engineers to develop a good understanding of the problems they are solving. You will therefore be expected to learn about the market research and consulting domain, work closely with our business stakeholders, and understand their workflows, challenges, and client needs. We believe that understanding the domain is essential to building genuinely useful AI applications rather than simply applying technology to a problem.

This role involves working with global stakeholders across different time zones. From time to time, you may be required to attend meetings outside your normal working hours. We support flexible working arrangements, allowing you to adjust your working hours accordingly when this is needed.

Why join Mintel?

We are the world's leading market intelligence agency and technology underpins our success. We help our clients understand consumers and consumer markets, and we aspire to provide the market intelligence behind every great business decision. Our technology allows us to deliver data, insights, and opinions in a compelling way to our clients across the globe.

Mintel is committed to building and supporting a diverse workforce, providing opportunities for all. 22% of our Engineering team and 23% of our Engineering leaders are women. We offer flexible working options and provide support, development and growth opportunities.

We support a hybrid working approach. Most of our colleagues work three days a week in our KL office and the rest of the week remotely.

  • Develop features and solve technical problems as part of an Agile team, working independently where appropriate while also pairing and collaborating with other Engineers and Architects.
  • Help deliver high-quality, reliable software through testing, code reviews, QA practices, documentation, and continuous improvement of our engineering practices.

  • An understanding of the challenges involved in moving generative AI beyond prototypes and into production, including reliability, observability, error handling, security, latency, cost, and the non-deterministic nature of LLM-based systems.
  • A good foundation in system design and software architecture, with an understanding of areas such as API design, data flows, application boundaries, scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.
